title: Implement wheel registration and delayed cohort reporting for Wheelwright web
description: Build a website/service feature where wheels can register and optionally share anonymized model-routing and execution telemetry. Public views expose trailing-average reports with a free 4-day delay, while fresher data can support paid tiers later. This is the networked path toward HIVE MIND model intelligence and shared optimization across users.
non_goals: Do not require cross-user sharing for local hub correctness
Do not expose fresh private data publicly in v1
Do not force enterprise hosting choices in this batch

must_be_sequential: 1. Define wheel registration contract and identity/privacy model.
2. Define anonymized telemetry ingest contract for shared model/advice intelligence.
3. Define trailing-average reporting and free 4-day delay policy.
4. Define paid fresher-data boundary and entitlements model at a design level.
5. Define how shared data feeds back into future hub model-routing intelligence without being required for local operation.
6. Define ranking/report surfaces such as most popular AI/model/provider, daily rankings, launch-day highs, and Model of the Week.

verification_requirements: Verify wheel registration is optional and privacy-aware
Verify public reporting is delayed by at least 4 days
Verify the design distinguishes free delayed insights from future paid fresher data
Verify this remains a future networked feature and not a dependency for local hub routing
Verify public/community-facing ranking surfaces are explicit and privacy-safe

acceptance_tests.description: Free delayed data policy is explicit
acceptance_tests.expected: Public data is trailing-average and delayed 4 days
Local hub routing works without cohort sharing

implementer_review.block_reason: Cluster 1 hub infrastructure (routing table + Octo) must be operational before product/commercial layer can be implemented. website/ directory does not yet exist.

workflow.handoff_reason: Blocked until Cluster 1 ships. Do not claim.

blocking_conditions: implementation-hub-model-routing-table-v1 must be accepted (hub owns model routing)
implementation-octo-gardener-dispatch-v1 must be accepted (hub orchestration must exist)
website/ directory and hosting infrastructure must be established before implementation begins
